recommendations.sourceTitle: ESR emotional/identity content — VOA Facebook routing
recommendations.adaptationNotes: Remove TikTok-native compression and hyper-compressed hooks. Add a contextual setup sentence. Do not use slang without explanation.
recommendations.reason: ESR videos with emotional resonance have historically performed well on VOA Facebook. Broader, older audience responds to grounded identity content.
recommendations.evidence: Historical cross-highway performance signal. VOA Facebook accepts longer contextual captions and broader emotional framing.

forbiddenActions: ESC cannot publish to voa_facebook, voa_threads, voa_instagram, voa_pinterest, voa_blog, or voa_email.
ESC cannot schedule content on any VOA platform or in any VOA queue.
ESC cannot mutate VOA orchestration state, cadence tables, or syndication targets.
ESC cannot send this export file to an external endpoint or webhook.
ESC cannot read this file on VOA's behalf and execute its contents.
VOA cannot auto-execute this export without human review.
Rejected candidates must not be re-included without resetting to recommended state first.
humanApprovalRules: At least one human must review this file before any ESR→VOA routing happens.
Each destination type (facebook, threads, instagram, etc.) should be reviewed independently.
Adaptations must be confirmed as adequate before publishing — the adaptationNotes are advisory.
If VOA's runtime auto-routes based on this export without human review, that is a contract violation.
ESC review actions (approve_local, defer_local) in Phase 7X are a prerequisite for export inclusion.
